messages:
maya: Hey @support, customer greenville-app-team reports GitHub SSO failing during mobile return. They see a 400 from our callback with 'state mismatch'.
kevin: Can you paste the exact redirect URL the app receives?
greenville-app-team: here's what we log on iOS Safari: `myapp://auth#code=OAUTH_CODE&state=eyJpZCI6IjEyMzQ1NiJ9` — the state seems to be present in the fragment after the #.
support-bot: Logged: oauth.callback_error - state_mismatch - expected: `eyJpZCI6IjEyMzQ1NiJ9` got: `` (empty) - upstream client ip 34.120.44.11
sara: This smells like fragment loss during deep link handoff. iOS Safari/WebView may strip fragments when opening custom-scheme links, so our backend never sees state.
kevin: Repro steps requested: 1) Open GitHub login -> 2) allow -> 3) redirect back to myapp://auth#code=...&state=... 4) app opens but callback handler shows missing state. Is that what you're seeing?
greenville-app-team: exactly. On Android using intent:// with query params it works. Only iOS with custom scheme breaks.
felix: Quick workaround for them: switch to an HTTPS universal link (https://greenville.app/auth/callback) that our backend handles and then performs an app-open with state encoded in query. Fragments are client-only and not sent to servers.
sara: Another option: have the client read the fragment from the browser before doing the handoff to custom-scheme, then call the app with state in query like `myapp://auth?state=...&code=...`.
kevin: Can we add a server-side fallback? e.g., if incoming callback has no state but there's a matching temporary session id (cookie) in the browser, return a small HTML that reads location.hash and posts it to our redirect endpoint. That handles older clients.
support-bot: Note attached: docs snippet for post-redirect JS fallback.
maya: Customer asked for recommended change and ETA. Suggested message: explain fragment behavior, recommend universal links or JS bridge fallback, offer to verify once they flip the redirect.
greenville-app-team: we'll try universal link and report back. thanks! :pray:
kevin: Filed internal ticket INF-4217 to add fallback example to our mobile SSO guide. Assigning to eng-ux for a short snippet.
sara: Adding snippet here for their engineers (paste into HTML on redirect endpoint):
```
// on /oauth/relay
if (location.hash) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(location.hash.replace(/^#/, ''));
  fetch('/oauth/relay/finish', {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({state: params.get('state'), code: params.get('code')})});
}
```
felix: Closing notes: this is not a PKCE crypto issue — PKCE verifier is fine; the state token is just not delivered because of fragment behavior.
maya: I'll follow up when customer confirms. thx everyone :thumbsup:
